Closing this because current `main` no longer contains the target `sorry` in `FormalBook/Chapter_28.lean`.

This patch was built against the SorryDB snapshot commit `865934361ca7005e0a874efb39f5809117052e85` and locally verified there with:

```bash
lake build FormalBook.Chapter_28
```

On current `main`, `Chapter_28.lean` has no `sorry`, so the PR is now obsolete rather than mergeable.

title: Prove edge cardinality step in Chapter 28 handshaking lemma
